maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body:
You could just keep using dictEntry for this. Unless Jim insists that it shall be opaque.

Personally I don't think it needs to be opaque. If it's transparent, this dict can be kept as a dict and you'd just use a mix of dict and hashtable API functions, which would be totally fine, since dict is a non-opaque synonom of hashtable. You'd only need to replace the one call to dictAddOrFind with the lower level functions.
